title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: data management framework telemetry in Application Insights
summary: Hold: the daily-cap automation entry is an operation description, not an executable REST request, and the claim that the cap stops all billable data omits the Auxiliary-table exception. The feature-enablement row also reports automation as undocumented although Microsoft documents importing Feature management settings.

claims.claim: Reaching a daily cap stops affected log collection until reset and impairs monitoring and alerts.
claims.quote:
Data collection resumes at the reset time which is a different hour of the day for each workspace.
This will impact your ability to monitor resources, receive alerts

stopping collection of billable log data for tables in the Analytics or Basic table plans

claims.fix: Replace the row note and matching governance sentence with: 'The workspace daily cap stops collection of billable log data in Analytics and Basic tables, not only DMF signals; Auxiliary tables are exempt.'

claims.claim: The workspace cap path is Azure portal > Log Analytics workspaces > workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Daily Cap > ON.
claims.quote:
From the Log Analytics workspaces menu, select your workspace, and then Usage and estimated costs.
Select Daily Cap at the top of the page.
Select ON and then set the data volume limit in GB/day.

claims.claim: Workspaces - Create Or Update with dailyQuotaGb under WorkspaceCapping is a runnable REST daily-cap call.
claims.quote: PUT https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/{workspaceName}?api-version=2026-03-01
claims.fix: Replace controls[3].api.call with 'PUT https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/<subscriptionId>/resourceGroups/<resourceGroupName>/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/<workspaceName>?api-version=2026-03-01; JSON body: {"location":"<workspace-region>","properties":{"workspaceCapping":{"dailyQuotaGb":<GB-per-day>}}}'. Set its docs to https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/loganalytics/workspaces/createorupdate and update the rendered API cell to match. The existing text gives neither an HTTP method nor a path, version or request body.

claims.claim: Setting a workspace daily cap requires Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/write, provided for example by Log Analytics Contributor.
claims.quote: Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/write permissions to the Log Analytics workspaces you set the daily cap on, as provided by the Log Analytics Contributor built-in role, for example.
